response.sql: WITH station_counts AS (SELECT o.observstation, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count FROM observatories AS o LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation) SELECT observstation, avg_bandwidth_usage, telescope_count, telescope_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(AVG(telescope_count) OVER (), 0) AS telescope_count_ratio FROM station_counts ORDER BY telescope_count_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: If every station has zero telescopes, the ratio is NULL because the average telescope count is zero.
